Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the overlapping screenwriter between Evolution (credited to David Diamond, David Weissman, and Don Jakoby) and The Family Man (credited to David Diamond and David Weissman). They incorrectly concluded the common writer was Don Jakoby, who did not write The Family Man. The correct overlap is David Weissman (also David Diamond), leading to the wrong final answer.
